defs.def: the forward movement of a group of people, especially armed forces （尤指武装部队的）前进，行进

ex.s: The Carlow Autumn Walking Festival is a great opportunity for the beginner, experienced or advanced walker to enjoy the challenges of Carlow’s mountain hikes or the peace of its woodland walks.
ex.t: Carlow秋季徒步节是初学者、有经验或高阶徒步者享受Carlow山地徒步挑战或林间漫步宁静的绝佳机会。

ex.s: The result is a diverse line of projects that each advance along their unique paths.
ex.t: 结果是形成了多样化的项目系列，每个项目都沿着各自独特的路径前进。

defs.def: progress or a development in a particular activity or area of understanding 进步；进展

ex.s: The most recent advances in solar technology.
ex.t: 太阳能技术的最新进展。

ex.s: Compared with the developments of Al, advances in ALife are harder to recognize.
ex.t: 与人工智能的发展相比，ALife的进展更难被识别。

ex.s: “If we're successful,” their mission statement reads, “we believe this will be one of the most important and widely beneficial scientific advances ever made.”
ex.t: "如果我们成功的话，"他们的使命声明写道，"我们相信这将是迄今为止最重要、最有益的科学进步之一。"

defs.def: money paid for work before it has been done or money paid earlier than expected 预付款
attempts to start a sexual relationship with sb 勾引；求爱；追求
an increase in the price or value of sth （价格、价值的）上涨，提高
before the time that is expected; before sth happens （时间上）在 … 前；预先；事先

ex.s: Very small drones with advanced sensors and AI and travelling ahead of the train could guide it like a co-pilot.
ex.t: 带有先进传感器和AI、在火车前方行驶的小型无人机，可以像副驾驶一样为它引路。

ex.s: The call for public engagement with the unthinkable is especially germane in this moment of still-uncontrolled pandemic and economic crises in the world's most technologically advanced nations.
ex.t: 公众参与讨论不可想象之事的呼吁在当今世界最发达的国家仍处于失控的大流行病和经济危机这一时刻尤其相关。

ex.s: It’s not all that hard to build an advanced and large vocabulary.
ex.t: 要构建一个高级而庞大的词汇量并不那么难。

ex.s: She decided to go back to college to advance her career and to be able to better support her family while doing something she loves: nursing.
ex.t: 她决定回到大学深造，以推进自己的事业，并在从事自己热爱的工作——护理——的同时，更好地支撑家庭。

defs.def: more developed than sb/sth else （发展上）超前
to move forward towards sb/sth, often in order to attack or threaten them or it （为了进攻、威胁等）前进，行进
if knowledge, technology, etc. advances, it develops and improves （知识、技术等）发展，进步

ex.s: We can, instead, use this idea to advance scientific knowledge.
ex.t: 相反，我们可以利用这个想法来推进科学知识。

ex.s: An advanced brain imaging technology.
ex.t: 一项先进的脑成像技术。

ex.s: At the core of Lancom is a world-class effective method that enhances language leaning with advanced technology.
ex.t: Lancom的核心是一种世界级的有效方法，借助先进技术提升语言学习。

ex.s: “It doesn't feel as alone as it may have before al the advances in technology,” said Laurie Demerit， whose company provided the statistics for the report.
ex.t: "随着技术的进步，这不像以前那样让人觉得孤单了，"劳里·德默里特说道，她的公司为这份报告提供了统计数据。

ex.s: Thanks to advances in technology, how we make friends and communicate with them has changed significantly.
ex.t: 由于技术的进步，我们如何与他们交朋友和沟通，已经发生了很大变化。

ex.s: For example, advances in virtual reality and wearable tech, as well as the BTP BETWEEN THE PAGES flexible battery, mean we should soon be seeing further developments.
ex.t: 例如，虚拟现实和可穿戴技术的进步，以及页面之间的BTP柔性电池，意味着我们很快就会看到进一步的发展。

defs.def: to help sth to succeed 促进；推动

ex.s: Technology advances science．
ex.t: A．技术推动科学。

ex.s: They help develop advanced skills.
ex.t: 它们有助于培养高级技能。

defs.def: to give sb money before the time it would usually be paid 预付
to suggest an idea, a theory, or a plan for other people to discuss 提出（想法、理论、计划）
to change the time or date of an event so that it takes place earlier 提前；提早

ex.s: Advance bookings are required(info@middletonlodge.co.uk.paris)
ex.t: 需要提前预订（info@middletonlodge.co.uk.paris）。

ex.s: Don’t forget to check in online and print your boarding pass in advance.
ex.t: 别忘了在线办理登机手续，并提前打印您的登机牌。

ex.s: Registration must be made at least two weeks in advance.
ex.t: 必须至少提前两周注册。

ex.s: call the police station in advance
ex.t: 提前给警察局打电话

ex.s: Which tour do you need to book in advance?
ex.t: 你需要提前预订哪个旅行？

ex.s: Advance reservations required.
ex.t: 需要提前预订。

ex.s: Make reservations in advance.
ex.t: 提前预订。

ex.s: Groups of five or more require special arrangements and must be confirmed in advance.
ex.t: 五人及以上的团体需要特别安排，并须提前确认。

ex.s: —Next time you visit Bob, remember to give him a call in advance.
ex.t: —下次你去看鲍勃，记得提前给他打个电话。

defs.def: to move forward to a later part of sth; to move sth forward to a later part 向前推（至下一步）；（使）向前移动

ex.s: You don’t have to use difficult words or advanced writing skills-expressing true feelings is the most important thing!
ex.t: 您不必使用困难的单词或高级写作技巧-表达真实的感受是最重要的！

ex.s: Going back to Walter Scott’s lines, we may find even white lies have results we cannot know in advance.
ex.t: 回到沃尔特·司各特的诗句，我们可能会发现即使是善意的谎言也会产生我们无法预知的结果。

defs.def: to increase in price or amount 价格、成本等
done or given before sth is going to happen 预先的；事先的
a group of people who go somewhere first, before the main group 先遣队；先头部队
